instruction: Inspect both images. For every opaque token, return two independent labels. coarse_roles describes visible/source layout: STREAM for every ordinary readable heading or body block, including advertisements and notices; MASTHEAD only for page-title/date/page-number fragments; OTHER for ornaments/non-reading elements; UNKNOWN if genuinely unreadable. Do not distinguish HEADER from TEXT: frozen software does that from geometry. editorial_genres describes function: ARTICLE, ADVERT, NOTICE, MASTHEAD, OTHER, or UNKNOWN. Genre never controls STREAM membership. Do not return eligibility, order, groups, articles, transcription, or fine physical roles. Mark uncertainty separately for each axis. Tokens are random. Return JSON only.

selected_on: A07 failure analysis on consumed page 0039 was used only to remove HEADER/TEXT from the model contract

axis_policy.coarse_role: STREAM means readable HEADER or TEXT; MASTHEAD, OTHER and UNKNOWN stay outside the main reading stream
axis_policy.fine_role: frozen CPU rule: a STREAM block is HEADER iff block_height / page_height <= 0.020, otherwise TEXT
axis_policy.editorial_genre: independent proposal that cannot remove readable content
axis_policy.semantic_units: frozen header-boundary CPU rule after fine-role refinement
axis_policy.genre_truth_status: proposal only: the distributed corpus has no independently adjudicated editorial genre labels

height_config.selection: maximum macro SSU pair F1 on development only, then fine-role accuracy, then smaller threshold

frozen_profile.reference_warning: Source physical roles/order/SSU remain provisional; editorial genres have no independent reference. This page cannot validate word geometry.

leakage_control: Random tokens reveal no source ID, order, physical role, genre or semantic unit. XML, binding and reference are outside the reader packet.
binding_control: Strict software validation binds both complete maps; no repair is permitted.
reference_warning: Physical role/order/SSU are provisional corpus labels. Editorial genre has no adjudicated reference and is not scored. Page 0044 is consumed after scoring.
